reviews.summary: A minute-by-minute plan you can follow tonight, with ways to keep him up and lines to say, where most pages for this search are generic lists.

dealbreakers: The countdown paragraph (EN and ES) now presents the lock as optional, then says without condition that if he taps early he gets a timer with your name on it and that the gift opens at twelve. Both are only true when 'Schedule the reveal' is on (ScheduledScreen in g/[shortId]/page.tsx) or for Midnight Countdown, which holds back its own gift. In every other countdown template, The Letter and Constellations included, the countdown is a timer block inside a gift that is already open (_shared/Countdown.tsx; the-letter/Template.tsx:632, constellations/Template.tsx:626). So someone who makes a free gift and sends it after dinner would have him reading the whole message at 9pm.
